manual_sections: 12.1 多模型组合与错误相关性实验

data.score_definition: out-of-fold calibrated probability per route (scripts/metrics_common.py; per-member temperature scaling fitted on inner-CV training logits)
data.correlation_scored_on: calibrated OOF probability; Spearman is invariant to any monotone rescaling, Pearson is not

protocol.cv: stratified 5-fold outer (random_state=42); 4-fold inner for calibration fitting (random_state=100+fold)
protocol.note: identical folds/seed/features as scripts/evaluate_system.py; no hyper-parameter or threshold selection on held-out folds
protocol.calibration: per-member temperature scaling (Guo et al. 2017); the temperature of a fold is fitted on inner-CV logits of the training fold, then applied to the held-out fold

preset_decision_rule.delta_rationale: 1/56 AI samples = 1.79 pp, so 0.02 is 'less than one corrected AI sample'; the manual (ch.12.1) asks for a threshold fixed before the experiment
preset_decision_rule.primary_fpr_rationale: the 1% guardrail is not resolvable with 63 real samples (0.01 < 1/63 = 1.59%), so the retention decision is taken at FPR=5%, where the ROC curve has several real points; the 1% Δ is still reported for completeness
preset_decision_rule.overlap_rationale: mean pairwise FP-set IoU >= 0.5 against every other route means the second route mostly repeats the first one's false alarms

forensic.definition: LR on L1(47)+L1b(20) forensic/domain features (trainable, deployed)
forensic.note: the 1% guardrail is not resolvable with 63 real samples (1 FP = 1.59% FPR); both integer budgets are reported

combined.definition: LR on L1(47)+L1b(20)+CLIP global(1024)+CLIP tiles(3072) (trainable, deployed)
combined.note: the 1% guardrail is not resolvable with 63 real samples (1 FP = 1.59% FPR); both integer budgets are reported

clip_domain.definition: LR on CLIP global features(1024) only (trainable, ablation channel)
clip_domain.note: the 1% guardrail is not resolvable with 63 real samples (1 FP = 1.59% FPR); both integer budgets are reported

clip_external.definition: frozen CLIP probe trained on the 18-generator benchmark (never trained on the 119)
clip_external.note: the 1% guardrail is not resolvable with 63 real samples (1 FP = 1.59% FPR); both integer budgets are reported

npr.definition: frozen NPR ResNet-18 logits on external benchmark shards (never trained on the 119)
npr.note: the 1% guardrail is not resolvable with 63 real samples (1 FP = 1.59% FPR); both integer budgets are reported

own_fpr1pct.note: each route thresholded at its own order statistic admitting 0 false positives on the real OOF scores (target FPR 1% is unreachable at n_real=63, where one FP already costs 1.59%)

frozen_common.note: every route compared against the frozen deployed thr_high from models/fusion.json, i.e. the decision the shipped pipeline would make if that route had been the only evidence

add_one_in_vs_incumbent_fusion.operating_point: threshold from the real OOF scores with a false-positive budget of 2 (target FPR 3% at 7:3)

deployed_frozen.granularity_note: TPR@FPR=1% is an integer count over 63 real samples: the 0.01 target is below the smallest achievable non-zero FPR (1/63 = 1.59%), so Δ values at 1% are dominated by one sample. The accompanying FPR-grid curve and the 5% column show the region where the ranking is resolvable.

conclusions.single_member_auc_note: a one-member fusion equals that route's clipped calibrated probability, so its AUC can differ from oof_auc in the 4th decimal (fusion.py clips at 1e-6)
conclusions.npr_note: npr is the weakest route (see single_route_table) and the stepwise table shows whether its incremental ΔTPR clears the pre-registered gate
conclusions.reading: a route is retained only if it clears the ΔTPR gate AND its errors are not dominated by overlap with the existing routes (manual ch.12.1)

limitations: All numbers are out-of-fold on the 119 competition samples; the analysis tables that include clip_domain/npr are analysis configurations, not the deployed fusion (models/fusion.json uses combined+forensic only).
TPR@FPR=1% cannot be measured exactly with 63 real samples (1 FP = 1.59%); the interpolated ROC value is reported and the integer granularity is noted wherever a Δ of one sample is discussed.
Error-set overlap is computed at a fixed operating point; a route that is redundant under one threshold can be complementary under another, so both conventions are reported.

conflict_resolved: manual ch.12.1 保留判据（ΔTPR@FPR=1% 低于事前门槛 -> 应移除）
manual ch.16.3 降级模式（深度模型全部不可用 -> L1 线索 + 阈值）

retained_member.name: forensic
retained_member.definition: LR on L1(47)+L1b(20) forensic/domain features (trainable, deployed)

actual_measurement.convention: leave_one_out.deployed_frozen (frozen weight table {'combined': 0.6, 'forensic': 0.25}, threshold = order statistic on the real OOF scores with an absolute false-positive budget of 2)
actual_measurement.gate_verdict_for_the_1pct_metric: below the pre-registered 0.02 ΔTPR@FPR=1% gate - candidate for removal

retention_basis: manual 16.3 降级路径的唯一实现载体：forensic 不依赖 CLIP 与 GPU 即可出分，移除它等于删掉降级模式（见 fallback_evidence）
保留带来可测的整体收益：准确率 +2.52 pp（0.9412 -> 0.9160）、ΔAUC +0.0026
在可分辨的操作点上同样有增益：ΔTPR@FPR=2% 与 3% = +0.0714（+7.14 pp，即多召回 4 个 AI 样本）
错误不冗余：mean FP-IoU vs 其余各路 = 0.1805 ≪ 0.5（passes_overlap_gate=True），不构成 12.1 要打击的「重复误报」情形
唯一低于门槛的指标是 ΔTPR@FPR=1%，而该指标在 63 张真实样本上不可分辨（1 FP = 1.59% > 1%），其 0.0 的读数是量化粒度产物而非能力缺失（三种口径中另两种均为正）

fallback_evidence.requirement: manual ch.16.3: 深度模型全部不可用 -> 退化为「L1 线索 + 阈值」模式，明确标注为降级模式
fallback_evidence.code_reference: repo/src/detector.py (forensic is scored from feature_vector(feat) (+) feature_vector_b(extract_l1b_features(parsed)) before any deep member; when clip/npr weights are absent only that member enters `scores` and fusion.py renormalises the weight to 1.0)
fallback_evidence.why_it_is_the_only_carrier: combined needs the CLIP backbone, clip_external and clip_domain need CLIP features, npr needs the NPR ResNet-18 on GPU; forensic is the only deployed-fusion member whose inputs are the CPU L1/L1b features, so removing it empties the 16.3 fallback of its only implemented route

standalone_fallback_operating_points.reading: the fallback is not competitive with the full fusion, but it is a real detector (AUC 0.9082; TPR 0.8393 at FPR 10%): degraded mode returns a usable, explicitly-marked verdict instead of no verdict

registration.declaration: 该豁免的判定依据（事前登记门槛 + 冻结产物上的留一法/重叠度实测）全部来自最终版本所依据的同一批冻结产物：本登记不修改任何冻结内容（成员清单、权重、阈值、温度均不变），也不引入任何新调参。文字登记的落盘时点晚于 models/fusion.json 的冻结时刻，因此「例外登记必须早于冻结」这一流程性要求在本次无法回溯满足，如实标记为 process_order_gap，只能在下一次版本冻结前完成。

what_pre_dates_the_freeze.gate: preset_decision_rule（Δ≥0.02、FP-IoU≤0.5、primary_fpr_level=5%）在本脚本源码中写死，先于其数值被读取（declared_before_measurement=true）
what_pre_dates_the_freeze.deployed_weights_decision: combined 0.6 + forensic 0.25 在最终一次性评测前即已冻结于 models/fusion.json

what_is_new_in_this_patch: forensic 的留一法 Δaccuracy/ΔAUC/FP-IoU/降级路径实测值（本指标包首次计算）

frozen_artifacts_unchanged.note: 本次登记前后 models/fusion.json 未改动

registration.process_order_gap: 登记落盘晚于冻结；若审计要求事前登记，需在下一次冻结流程中把「例外登记」列为冻结前置项

insufficient_evidence.why: 实质依据（16.3 唯一降级载体 + 准确率/AUC 正增益 + FP-IoU 0.1805 不冗余 + 1% 指标在 n=63 下不可分辨）可在冻结产物上复算，判定为充分；唯一不成立的是「登记早于冻结」的流程顺序声明。

if_the_exception_is_rejected.action: 移除 forensic，融合退化为 combined 单路

cost.degraded_mode: 消失：无 CLIP/GPU 时不再有任何可出分的成员，手册 16.3 降级路径不再成立

if_the_exception_is_rejected.team_recommendation: 保留并登记（本审计亦不建议删模型，见 docs/compliance-audit.md F1 / 第 4 节问题②）

additional_experiments_if_challenged: 用一组只有 L1/L1b 输入的真实困难负样本（渲染态单据/翻拍件）复测降级模式的 FPR 上界，量化 16.3 路径的业务可用性
在更大真实语料（≥100 张独立纯真实）上重算 ΔTPR@FPR=1%，确认该门槛在可分辨样本量下的真实读数（当前 63 张下 1% 目标不可达）
degradation_path_exception.audit_reference: docs/compliance-audit.md F1 / 第 4 节问题②（修补建议：补登记而非删模型）
